_readme.title: Vayu + VIB Integrator Roadmap
_readme.source: Synchronized from the current NotY215/Vayu Roadmap.md and codebase on 2026-10-30.
_readme.status_policy: Use only completed, working, planned, and vacation as status values. Phase 10 is the current working phase. Native machine-code generation remains planned; implemented VIR execution and .vye packaging do not mean native code generation is complete.

phase_status.completed: Implemented and accepted with evidence in the core roadmap.
phase_status.planned: Accepted future work that has not started.

_readme.notes: Synchronized with the newest core repository roadmap: phases 0 through 9 are completed; Phase 10 is working on built-ins and additional language coverage; phases 11 through 14 remain planned. The VIB VIR subset, verifier, control flow, collections, modules, .vye packaging, Integrator dispatch, and opt-in artifact caching are implemented as documented. Native machine-code generation is still planned. Do not imply all interpreter/VM features are supported by VIB.
